leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-first season of , Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-first season of , Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures Collections were released by in 2018 and 2019.

===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on December 5, 2018 and in New Zealand on December 12, 2018. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE8053.

====Contents====
 
 
===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on February 6, 2019 and in New Zealand on February 20, 2019. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE8094.

====Contents====
 
 

==Season 21 disc set==
 
 
The Season 21 DigiPack disc set, also referred to as Pokémon The Series: Sun & Moon - Ultra Adventures Complete Collection in promotional material, was released by in Australia on April 3, 2019 and in New Zealand on May 15, 2019. It contains six discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE8136.

 
===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of one specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures episodes.
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection
